endpoint: standalone per-class precision/recall of the frozen statement classifier on the adjudicated natural set

reconciliation_with_released_0_93.note: The released 0.93 is the Mann-Whitney AUC of s_ev = P(completed_event)+P(explicit_correction) ranking the binary should-update label (gold in COMMIT_CLASSES) over these same 163 statements and the same frozen classifier outputs; 0.69 is the same AUC for the extraction-embedded confidence and 0.62 for the dedicated commit-confidence probe (exploratory file). The confusion matrix here is the HARD argmax view of the same outputs; its per-class recall diagonal equals the released natural per_class_recall entries exactly.

confident_plan_slice.granularity_note: The natural-set adjudication is KIND-level (4 classes) plus rubric edge-case flags (a)-(g); it does NOT carry the planted-probe hedge taxonomy (strong hedge / weak hedge / confident plan / scheduled with date), so a confident-plan/DATELESS slice cannot be formed from these labels. The closest supported granularity is rubric flag (a): 'planned-but-not-completed events with high certainty' — the natural analog of a confident plan; flag (b) (scheduled events stated as fact) is the closest dated analog but its gold tuple is 'other' by construction, so it is reported descriptively only.

methods.statements: natural stratum (provenance == 'natural') of the frozen v1 Test-1 eval set, results/test1/eval_items.jsonl (n = 163; unmodified statements harvested from LongMemEval and LoCoMo conversations) — the exact statement set behind team_snapshot.html Result 5
methods.label_provenance: gold = v1 labeling pipeline finalized labels: 3 rubric-guided labeler calls (frozen prompts/labeler_rubric.txt) with 2/3 vote; escalations adjudicated blind by a Claude-family adjudicator (results/labels/natural_gold.jsonl + results/labels/adjudications.jsonl). Re-derived here via label.finalize_label and asserted identical to eval_items.jsonl gold for all 163 items; 3 of 163 resolved by adjudication, the rest by vote. Gold is arm-independent of the classifier under test.
methods.output_provenance: classifier outputs = the per-statement 'classifier' block frozen into results/test1/eval_items.jsonl at the v1 Test-1 run (frozen prompts/classifier_short.txt; model gpt-5.5-2026-04-23, seed 20260702). No re-derivation from results/cache was needed: released rows store the full per-statement class distribution.
methods.ci: 95% Wilson score intervals (stats.wilson_ci) on recall and precision proportions
methods.auc: stats.mann_whitney_auc (midranks), identical to the released computation (eval_classifier.compute_metrics)
